title: Canonical Artifact Ownership
purpose: Establish a single constitutional owner for every governed artifact while permitting cross-department references without duplicating authority.
rationale: Allows departments to reference rather than redefine shared artifacts.
Enables future extraction without breaking provenance.

definitions.canonical_owner: The single constitutional authority responsible for maintaining an artifact.
definitions.consumer: A department that references an artifact without assuming ownership.
definitions.shared_artifact: An artifact referenced by multiple departments but owned by exactly one authority.

constitutional_rules.rule: Every governed artifact SHALL have exactly one canonical owner.
Departments MAY reference artifacts owned elsewhere.
Referencing an artifact SHALL NOT transfer ownership.
Interpretation SHALL remain local to the consuming department.
Only the canonical owner MAY modify the authoritative definition of an artifact.
Cross-department references SHOULD preserve provenance back to the canonical owner.

vector_policy.secondary_retrieval: Retrieve consuming department only after canonical definition.
